summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics filed a Form 6-K reporting open-market share repurchases under a program announced June 9, 2026. Between June 10-12, 2026, the company bought back 38,537 ordinary shares on Euronext Brussels at an average price of €24.78, totaling €0.95 million. No price premium, board recommendation, or advisor is mentioned. The repurchase is funded from existing capital with no structural complexity or regulatory clock. As a non-US issuer reporting under Rule 13a-16, the filing is equivalent to a U.S. issuer's share buyback disclosure. Watch for continued execution under the program; no risk-arb angle applies as this is an issuer capital return, not a control event.
